items.text: A Ravens injury:

quoted.text:
Ravens WR Zay Flowers limped off the field favoring his left leg about an hour into practice. The 2-time Pro Bowl WR walked off on his own and did not need a cart. 

Flowers collided with safety Jaylinn Hawkins over the middle during a 7-on-7 drill. He immediately fell to the ground.

Flowers had trouble getting up before getting looked at by trainers, who flexed his left leg. 

Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry came over to check on Flowers. Ravens GM Eric DeCosta also spoke to Flowers while being looked at by trainers.

It was only three days ago when Flowers signed a four-year, $140 million extension.

Ravens coach Jesse Minter will talk after practice.
